categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai Haoyuan Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. primarily operates in three main business segments: life science reagents (including molecular building blocks, tool compounds, and biochemical reagents), pharmaceutical intermediates and APIs (active pharmaceutical ingredients), and drug formulations including CDMO services. The company provides integrated services covering the entire pharmaceutical supply chain from starting materials to intermediates, APIs, and formulations, with a focus on small molecule and new molecular drug discovery and production.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies such as high-activity API synthesis, asymmetric synthesis, chiral catalysis, coupling technology, ozone oxidation, photochemical reactions, crystallization and polymorph screening, enzymatic catalysis, fluorination, and click chemistry. It also employs high-throughput screening, fluid chemistry, biocatalysis, and continuous flow photochemistry. The company has developed proprietary compound libraries and platforms for ADC (antibody-drug conjugates), PROTAC, peptides, nucleic acids, and other novel drug modalities, supported by GMP-compliant production lines and integrated CMC/CDMO capabilities.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Haoyuan Pharmaceutical serves over 13,000 global partners including multinational pharmaceutical giants such as Pfizer, JNJ, Lilly, MSD, Roche, and BMS, as well as leading academic and research institutions like NIH, Chinese Academy of Sciences, Tsinghua University, Peking University, Harvard, Oxford, and Cambridge. The customer base spans pharmaceutical companies, biotech firms, CROs, and academic research labs engaged in drug discovery and development worldwide.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with business hubs and sales teams in China, the United States, Europe, Japan, South Korea, Singapore, and India. It has established multiple R&D and production centers in Shanghai, Anhui, Shandong, Chongqing, and other Chinese provinces, as well as subsidiaries and offices in the US, UK, Germany, and Japan, supporting a broad international market presence.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shanghai Haoyuan Pharmaceutical operates across the pharmaceutical supply chain, covering upstream molecular building blocks and tool compounds, midstream pharmaceutical intermediates and APIs, and downstream drug formulations and CDMO services. It integrates R&D, custom synthesis, process development, and commercial manufacturing, positioning itself as a full-cycle service provider from early drug discovery to commercial production.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation-driven growth, focusing on expanding compound libraries, advancing ADC, PROTAC, peptide, and nucleic acid drug platforms, and integrating AI technologies for drug discovery. It prioritizes global market expansion, quality management, and digital transformation. R&D investments target high-barrier, high-value products and green chemistry technologies, with ongoing development of new molecular types and enhanced CDMO capabilities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through product sales of molecular building blocks, tool compounds, biochemical reagents, pharmaceutical intermediates, APIs, and formulations, combined with technical service fees from custom synthesis, process development, and CDMO services. Sales channels include direct sales and distributors, with a mix of fee-for-service and full-time equivalent (FTE) billing models for technical services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Haoyuan Pharmaceutical is a leading domestic player in China's small molecule drug discovery and production sector, with strong international influence in life science reagents and tool compounds. It is recognized as a top-tier competitor in ADC payload-linker development and CDMO services, holding a competitive edge in high-barrier, complex molecule synthesis and integrated service platforms. The company has received multiple industry awards and maintains a robust brand presence globally.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 2.27 billion, a 20.75% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 201.59 million, up 58.17%. Total assets grew by 31.31% to RMB 5.5 billion, with equity increasing 14.7%. The company maintains strong cash flow, increased R&D investment at 10% of revenue, and has a workforce of 3,576 employees including 391 R&D personnel.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Haoyuan Pharmaceutical offers a comprehensive, integrated service platform covering the entire pharmaceutical supply chain, distinguished by its extensive proprietary compound libraries, advanced synthesis technologies, and high-quality GMP manufacturing. Its globalized brand and customer-centric approach provide differentiated, high-value products and customized technical services that accelerate drug discovery and development, reduce costs, and improve efficiency for clients worldwide.
